scenes.text: She let the stranger sleep on the couch for one night, out of the rain.
scenes.art_prompt: a small front room at night lit by one lamp, rain on the window, an empty couch, uneasy

scenes.text: At three in the morning she heard the front door open and close. He was gone.
scenes.art_prompt: an open front door onto a dark wet street, streetlight glow, unsettling calm

scenes.text: She locked it. The next night, the door opened again at three.
scenes.art_prompt: a dark hallway with a closed front door, deadbolt turned, faint shadow underneath

scenes.text: No one came in. No one went out. The bolt stayed thrown.
scenes.art_prompt: a close-up of a deadbolt still locked, a thin line of light under the door

scenes.text:
She checked the couch each morning.
The cushion still held the shape of someone sitting there all night.
scenes.art_prompt: a couch cushion with a deep impression in the dark, single lamp, horror

scenes.text: Follow Quiet Horror Files for more.
scenes.art_prompt: a dark house seen from the street at 3 a.m., one window lit, final dread
